headline.purpose: The selected repair title, not decorative display text.

title.purpose: Queue, message, proposal, and activity headings.

body.purpose: Repair summaries and explanations up to 68ch wide.

label.purpose: Compact actor, state, field, and action labels.

shadows.name: temporary-feedback
shadows.purpose: Notices and error banners only; static panels remain flat.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Immediate 0.97 scale feedback for pointer actions.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Color and border changes for hover and selection.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single clear decision on a case, such as Approve and book.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-primary); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-primary); color: white; font: 720 .9rem/1.2 ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary) 48%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A reversible supporting action, never a competing primary decision.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-primary); border-radius: 8px; background: white; color: var(--color-primary); font: 720 .9rem/1.2 ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-pale); } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary) 48%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Message Field
components.description: A familiar SMS composer with a direct recipient label.
components.html: <input class="ds-message-field" aria-label="Message to tenant" placeholder="Message Maya…">
components.css: .ds-message-field { min-height: 48px; width: 100%; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong); border-radius: 8px; background: white; color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 .88rem/1.5 ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-message-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary) 48%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Repair
components.description: The current case in the repair queue.
components.css: .ds-repair-card { width: 100%; display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary) 32%, var(--color-border)); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-primary-pale); color: var(--color-ink); text-align: left; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-repair-card span { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .82rem; } .ds-repair-card:hover { background: var(--color-primary-soft); } .ds-repair-card:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-repair-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary) 48%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Agent Message
components.description: A repair-agent message shown in the same conversation as tenant texts.
components.html:
Thanks. I’m arranging a plumber now.

10:42
components.css: .ds-agent-message { width: fit-content; max-width: 26rem; padding: 12px 14px 9px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary) 24%, var(--color-border)); border-radius: 12px 8px 12px 12px; background: var(--color-primary-pale); color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 .88rem/1.5 ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-agent-message p { margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-agent-message time { display: block; color: var(--color-primary); font-size: .7rem; text-align: right; }

components.name: Approval Status
components.description: A consequential waiting state that names what the property manager must do.
components.css: .ds-status-attention { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 34px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-attention) 38%, var(--color-border)); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-attention-pale); color: oklch(.37 .08 70); font: 690 .86rem/1.2 ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; }

components.name: Proposal Source
components.description: Distinguishes stored agreement terms from an exceptional external quote.
components.css: .ds-proposal-source { display: inline-flex; padding: 6px 9px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-primary-pale); color: var(--color-primary); font: 680 .74rem/1.3 ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: A quiet, structured operations desk where the repair queue, shared case record, and human approval trail stay visible. Agent work is auditable but never decorative, and every consequential action is named in ordinary English.
keyCharacteristics: one obvious decision at a time

rules.name: The Restrained Green Rule
rules.body: Dispatch Green appears only on current selection, primary action, focus, connected state, and confirmed success.

rules.name: The Ordinary English Rule
rules.body: Labels describe exactly what happens and never hide the result behind workflow jargon.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Static work surfaces use tonal layering and borders; shadow is reserved for temporary feedback.

dos: Do make the active repair and required approval obvious.
Do keep messages readable, familiar, and clearly attributed.
Do use 100–220ms state transitions with strong ease-out curves.
donts: Don't make this look or behave like a generic SaaS demo.
Don't add guided scenarios, fake metrics, marketing language, decorative dashboard filler, or simulated controls.
Don't turn the product into a futuristic AI console.
Don't use vague action labels when the real result can be named.
